description: Opt-in guards on git commit, git add, git push and gh pr, opt-in refusals of an untimed background wait loop and of pkill -f or pgrep -f, an opt-in refusal of a subagent call that would silently inherit the session's model, an opt-in check that an email draft opens with the greeting for the time of day, an opt-in restart of idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code, and an opt-in budget mode that routes work to cheaper models while the usage allowance burns too fast. The hooks module checks the main thread's git commands; the Bash PreToolUse hook checks subagents' and every call when the module did not load. Each is off until switched on in /config; a hook whose options are all off does not start python3.

hooks.command: s=; for on in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_BACKGROUND_LOOPS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_PKILL_FULL"; do case "$on" in true) s=--shapes ;; esac; done; for on in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_ATTRIBUTION_TRAILERS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_COMMITS_MD" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_WARN_MAIN_CHECKOUT_COMMIT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_SECRETS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_LONG_BODIES" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_BACKGROUND_LOOPS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_PKILL_FULL"; do case "$on" in true) phylax_rc=; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git_guards.py" $s; phylax_rc=$?; case $phylax_rc in 0|2) exit $phylax_rc ;; esac; fi; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/no_python3.sh" || { echo 'phylax: hooks/no_python3.sh is missing, so this phylax install is broken and cannot check this command; it was not run. Reinstall phylax, or turn off its options in /config, or run /phylax:setup.' >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; done
